description: Fix orchestrator.ts stability issues: wire BOT_MODE and BOT_MAX_CAUSAS env vars, remove hardcoded 10-detail limit, replace page.goBack() with safe navigation back to list, make years configurable via env var, call markCausaScraped after detail scraping, and fix the CHECK constraint issue by mapping RIT types correctly.
steps: In src/bot/config/index.ts, add new config fields: 'maxDetailsPorSesion' (number, default 50), 'years' (string[], default ['2026','2025','2024']). Update the BotConfig interface in src/bot/types/index.ts to include these new fields.

In src/bot/index.ts main() function: Read process.env.BOT_MODE and process.env.BOT_MAX_CAUSAS. If BOT_MODE === 'urgent_only', call runUrgentOnly(credentials). If BOT_MODE === 'test_single', call runTestSingle(credentials). If BOT_MAX_CAUSAS is set, pass { maxCausasPorSesion: parseInt(BOT_MAX_CAUSAS) } to runBotSession. Default is 'normal' mode which calls runBotSession with standard config.

In src/bot/modules/orchestrator.ts line ~161: Replace 'const maxDetails = Math.min(cfg.maxCausasPorSesion, 10)' with 'const maxDetails = cfg.maxDetailsPorSesion || 50'. The env var BOT_MAX_CAUSAS should also control this via the config object.

In src/bot/modules/orchestrator.ts: Replace 'await page.goBack()' (line ~174) with a safe approach: Instead of going back, re-navigate to the results by re-clicking Mis Causas link and then the Familia tab (using the same navigateToConsulta function or a lighter version). NEVER use page.goBack() as it can lose session (same issue as page.goto).

In src/bot/modules/orchestrator.ts: Replace hardcoded years array "['2026', '2025', '2024']" with cfg.years or a fallback read from process.env.BOT_YEARS (comma-separated). Default should be ['2026', '2025', '2024'].
In src/bot/modules/orchestrator.ts: After successful detail scraping (after saveCausaData call), add a call to markCausaScraped(causaDb.id) - it's already imported but never called.

In src/bot/modules/orchestrator.ts: Fix the tipo mapping when inserting new causas. Currently: tipo: pc.rit.startsWith('P') ? 'P' : pc.rit.startsWith('C') ? 'C' : pc.rit.startsWith('X') ? 'X' : null. The schema CHECK constraint only allows 'P' and 'X'. Change to: tipo: pc.rit.startsWith('P') ? 'P' : pc.rit.startsWith('X') ? 'X' : null. Causas starting with 'C' or other letters should have tipo = null to avoid constraint violation.
acceptance_criteria: BOT_MODE env var controls which function is called (normal/urgent_only/test_single)
BOT_MAX_CAUSAS env var is read and passed to config.maxCausasPorSesion
Detail scraping limit is configurable via maxDetailsPorSesion, not hardcoded to 10
page.goBack() is removed and replaced with safe navigation that doesn't lose session
Years are configurable via BOT_YEARS env var or config
markCausaScraped is called after successful detail scraping
tipo field only inserts 'P' or 'X' (matching schema CHECK constraint), never 'C'
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and confirm no TypeScript errors
findings: TypeScript compilation cannot fully verify in INTEGRATIONS_ONLY environment (no node_modules). All errors in bot files are TS2591 (missing @types/node for process/require/module) or TS2307 (missing module declarations for playwright, @supabase/supabase-js). No logic errors introduced by our changes. Also fixed tsconfig target from es5 (removed in TS 5.5+) to es2017 so tsc can actually parse the project. Pre-existing implicit-any errors remain in supabaseSync.ts but are unrelated to this feature.
